collection.detail_batch_rule: At most12 TWT49U events intersecting retained historical entry/holding/exit windows, sorted by (effective_date,ticker); exclude the two V1 details already retained. Outcome/return values must not select requests. If fewer than12 affected events, use only those. Never regenerate missing windows.
collection.failure_retention: Immutable raw bytes plus SHA256/fetch/HTTP/validation receipts for every attempted request, including errors. HTTP200 does not mean validated data. Do not retry blocked access or purchase anything.
stop_conditions: payment/delivery or identity timing cannot be proven -> block dependent observation
paid/private access or CAPTCHA/rate limit -> stop source subtask
conflicting terms -> CONFLICT, no guessed resolution
missing original event windows -> UNKNOWN, no signal regeneration
no auction allocation -> UNKNOWN, no guaranteed fill

completion: Produce all required artifacts even when UNKNOWN. STOP after V2 for human review; no automatic model search, merge or promotion.
publication_lineage: Actual fetch times != historical first-seen; missing publication/revision dates remain null. No current security-master substitution.

schemas.ENTITLEMENT_LEDGER: hash-chained append-only assertions with event_id, supersedes_record_hash, old/new security IDs, effective/last_trade/resumption, cash/share/subscription/deadline/payment/delivery/fractional fields, evidence provenance, status PROVEN/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT, authority
schemas.EVENT_CLASSIFICATION: event_id, original source/row/hash, PIT evidence, effective_date,ticker, category, candidate_categories,classification_status,authority
schemas.EXECUTION_EVIDENCE: each retained one-price/censor observation, BUY entry and SELL exit separately; intended signal timing/order-price assumptions, actual reference/OHLC/volume, auction evidence, PROVEN/DISPROVEN/UNKNOWN fill
schemas.HISTORICAL_IMPACT_MAP: one trial inventory row per8529 and observation rows for retained windows only; entry/holding/exit intersections, original treatment, missing fields; unretained windows explicitly UNKNOWN
schemas.IDENTITY_TRANSITIONS: event_id, old/new ticker and security IDs, economic vs listed-instrument continuity, ratios only where explicit, source hashes, UNKNOWN when not proven
schemas.READINESS: global/event/date/identity/window/execution/first-seen coverage separately; blocked scopes named. No claim of complete mapping where windows were never retained.

state_machine_scope: Evidence/readiness diagnostics only. Actual adjusted-return/PnL engine BLOCKED unless all required fields proven. Synthetic fixtures may exercise states; no empirical outcome calculation.
